title: 第17章 江旭上门第18章 痴人说梦
lines: 这一礼，代表着江战从今往后便是“新江家”
的家主。
二十个旁系子弟外加他们的家人，一共近五十号人，便是新江家的基本盘。
江战看着这些人，想到父亲江承志对自己的绝情，心中不禁泛起浓浓的苦涩。
常婉茹看出丈夫的心情，轻轻握住了江战的手。
怀里的江雪也紧紧搂着爹爹的脖子。
江战看了一眼妻子和孩子，重新打起精神，对众人说道：“承蒙诸位看得起我这个废人。”
“从今日起，我们便不再是江家人，我会带领你们在西区暂时落脚。”
“等稳定下来之后，再谋他事。”
众人闻言，纷纷附和：“是，家主！”
随后，江战便带领族人一同前往西区宅子。
与此同时，江家二少爷退出江家一事，如一阵风一般迅速传遍了玄武城。
作为玄武城四大家族之一的江家，发生了这么大的事，自然引起了许多关注。
对于其他几大家族而言，这件事更多只是抱着看热闹的心态，将其当成一桩笑话。
毕竟众所周知，江家二少爷江战早就于几年前的矿脉争夺事件中残废，其大儿子江尘也是一个废武魂。
再加上一些无关紧要的旁系，这些人的退出，对于江家这个庞大家族来说，不会造成太大影响。
然而，不管有没有影响，江家在这次事件中可谓是丢尽了脸面。
据说家主江承志回房之后，气的大发雷霆，将一屋子的瓶瓶罐罐砸了个稀巴烂，就连管家王四平也遭殃被砸破了头。
所有人都知道，这件事还没完。
在一众族人面前，江承志碍于脸面没有对公然反抗的江战进行惩罚，使其带着一群叛徒安然退出，
但以江承志的性格，为了挽回面子，事后势必会对这一家人发出报复。
现在的平静，不过是暴风雨来临的前兆。
这里就是我们以后生活的地方吗？”
年纪尚小的江雪对这一切并不知晓。
看到自己的新家有一个巨大的院子，顿时高兴的在里面欢呼跳跃起来。
新家是一个三进的宅子，因为许久未曾打理，里面杂草丛生，到处都是蚊虫粪便。
好在人手够多，清理起来并不难。
在众人清理的档口，江尘在宅子里大致转了转，发现里面共有三十多间屋子，足够一群人居住，但也仅限于此了。
等到以后人数多起来了，迟早要换地方。
“这间宅子大小在西区算是中上，但因为地理位置偏僻，且处于‘贱区’，所以一直都找不到愿意出价的主顾。”
“没成想，今日竟成了我们一家人的容身之地。”
江战在清理过程中，与家人有一搭没一搭的说着话，语气中颇有些失落。
看向妻儿的目光中，也带着几分愧疚。
江尘知道父亲在想什么。
江战当年也是江家的一位天才，身怀四品武魂，年纪轻轻便已是高阶武师，有很大几率在三十五岁之前开辟真元突破武宗。
谁知数年前，在一场涵盖五大家族的矿脉争夺战中，江承志为了夺取更多矿脉开采权，逼迫江战不得不独自与其他几家的武师展开车轮战。
后来江战因为力竭，被对方下狠手打的经脉断裂，从此成了废人。
如果江战没有因为此事被废的话，如今很可能已经成为江家除家主江承志以外唯一的武宗。
content_en:
This gift means that Jiang Zhan will be the "New Jiang Family" from now on.
The head of the family.
Twenty collateral descendants plus their families, a total of nearly fifty people, are the basic base of the Xinjiang family.
Jiang Zhan looked at these people and couldn't help but feel deep bitterness in his heart when he thought of his father Jiang Chengzhi's unkindness towards him.
Chang Wanru saw her husband's mood and gently held Jiang Zhan's hand.
Jiang Xue in her arms also hugged her father's neck tightly.
Jiang Zhan glanced at his wife and children, cheered up again, and said to everyone, "Thank you for your respect for this useless person like me."
"From today on, we are no longer the Jiang family. I will lead you to settle down temporarily in the West District."
"Wait until things stabilize and then look for other things."
When everyone heard this, they all agreed: "Yes, the head of the family!"
Afterwards, Jiang Zhan led his tribe to the West District house.
At the same time, the news that the second young master of the Jiang family had withdrawn from the Jiang family quickly spread throughout Xuanwu City like a gust of wind.
As one of the four major families in Xuanwu City, such a big thing happened to the Jiang family, which naturally attracted a lot of attention.
For the other major families, this incident was more of a spectator mentality and regarded it as a joke.
After all, as we all know, the second young master of the Jiang family, Jiang Zhan, had been disabled in the mine dispute a few years ago, and his eldest son, Jiang Chen, was also a useless martial spirit.
Coupled with some insignificant collaterals, the withdrawal of these people will not have much impact on the Jiang family, a large family.
However, regardless of the impact or not, the Jiang family was completely humiliated in this incident.
It is said that after the family owner Jiang Chengzhi returned to his room, he became furious and smashed all the bottles and cans in the room. Even the housekeeper Wang Siping suffered a disaster and his head was smashed.
Everyone knows that this matter is not over yet.
In front of a crowd of tribesmen, Jiang Chengzhi did not punish Jiang Zhan for openly resisting out of shame, allowing him to safely withdraw with a group of traitors.
But with Jiang Chengzhi's character, in order to save face, he would definitely retaliate against the family afterwards.
The current calm is just a precursor to the coming storm.
~~
"Wow!
Is this where we will live in the future? "
Jiang Xue, who is still young, does not know all this.
When I saw that my new home had a huge yard, I immediately jumped for joy inside.
The new home is a three-story house that has not been taken care of for a long time. It is overgrown with weeds and full of mosquito droppings.
Fortunately, there are enough people, so cleaning up is not difficult.
At the stall where everyone was cleaning up, Jiang Chen walked around the house and found that there were more than thirty rooms in it, which was enough for a group of people to live in, but that was all.
When the number of people increases in the future, sooner or later the place will have to be changed.
"The size of this house is considered to be above average in the West District, but because it is located in a remote location and is in a 'cheap area,' we have never been able to find a customer willing to bid."
"Unexpectedly, today it has become a shelter for our family."
During the cleaning process, Jiang Zhan kept talking to his family, with a somewhat disappointed tone.
There was also a hint of guilt in the eyes he looked at his wife and children.
Jiang Chen knew what his father was thinking.
Jiang Zhan was also a genius of the Jiang family back then. He possessed a fourth-grade martial spirit and was already a high-level martial artist at a young age. He had a high chance of developing true energy and breaking through the martial arts sect before he was thirty-five years old.
Unexpectedly, a few years ago, in a battle for mineral veins involving five major families, Jiang Chengzhi forced Jiang Zhan to fight alone with martial arts masters from other families in order to seize more mining rights.
Later, due to exhaustion, Jiang Zhan's meridians were severed by the opponent's brutal blow, and he became a disabled person from then on.
If Jiang Zhan had not been deposed because of this incident, he would probably have become the only martial sect of the Jiang family besides the head of the family, Jiang Chengzhi.
